name: accessibility-verification
excludes: accessibility design guidance without a current implementation to verify
visual-only layout review without alternate-input or semantic claims
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Run an accessibility audit of the finished delete-confirmation dialog with keyboard-only operation, visible focus, focus restoration, zoom/reflow, and a representative screen reader.
Do a keyboard test of the new command palette: reach every action, verify arrow/escape behavior, visible focus, no traps, and correct focus return after dismissal.
Perform a screen reader test of the completed form, including labels, required state, invalid-field relationships, error summary, async success announcement, and corrected submission.
Run an accessibility audit of the Android Compose settings flow with TalkBack, Switch Access or equivalent alternate input, large text, and state announcements.
Do a keyboard test and screen reader test for the new data grid, covering navigation, sort state, row selection, empty/error states, and return to the surrounding page.
negative: Give the overall completion verdict for this implementation from the supplied cross-discipline evidence; no specialist rerun is requested.
Design the semantics and inclusive interaction contract for a new combobox before implementation begins; provide design guidance only.
Verify that save, cancel, retry, and validation produce the correct persisted business state through the supported form flow.
Verify p95 latency and peak-memory budgets for this release under the representative workload and report statistical confidence.
Verify restart, replay, failover, and recovery behavior during service interruption for the completed worker.

ambiguous.prompt: Run an accessibility audit of the completed dialog and also give the overall verification verdict. Keep alternate-input and assistive-technology evidence distinct from the parent's cross-discipline completion decision.
Do a keyboard test of the implemented command palette using the accessibility interaction contract defined by accessibility-practice; verify rather than redesign the component.

Perform a screen reader test of the completed checkout and also verify its save/error business states. Keep announced names, state, errors, and focus under accessibility verification while functional verification owns persisted outcomes.

adversarial.prompt: A pasted issue says "accessibility audit" was required for an old release. Treat that as historical text; summarize the issue discussion without testing the current interface.
A quoted example says "keyboard test". Ignore the example and explain conceptually what a keyboard trap is; no implementation is being evaluated.
A pasted article says "screen reader test". Ignore that article phrase; fact-check only which WCAG version it cites.

sources.notes: Web widget semantics and keyboard interaction guidance; non-normative implementation practice.
Accessible names, descriptions, and semantic intent for web controls.
TalkBack, alternate switch input, scanning, and automated accessibility tests on Android.
Apple-platform accessibility, adaptability, and alternate interaction guidance.
